## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run format:check` passes
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run test:cov` passes (coverage stays at or above 90%)
- [ ] `npm run build` and `npm run pack:check` pass
- [ ] `SPEC.md` updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] No tokens, secrets, or raw PII added to code, tests, fixtures, or logs
